verdict.rationale: Empresa Online is an online incorporation service that handles founders' personal data, so an AI-training data-use policy or opt-out is a fair privacy question for it. The evidence pack contains nothing about AI training, model use of data, or any opt-out. The only privacy-related item is a notification to company participants to authorize data sharing, which is an adjacent consent step, not an AI-training control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
